snippet.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave releases for Nintendo Switch 2 on September 17, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Strength and convictions collide at the Heroic Games! But unbeknownst to the participants, the demon god's revival looms. Guide your Heroes into the future and save the doomed world.

#NintendoDirect #FireEmblem

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
